## MockTelegramServer.sendCallbackQuery() method

Simulate a user pressing an inline keyboard button (callback query).

**Signature:**


## Remarks

Constructs a callback query update with the specified `data` payload. The bot under test should answer with `answerCallbackQuery` and optionally edit the message.
